from pathlib import Path
program='''def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    starts = list(range(0, cols - 1, 3))
    panels = [[row[c:c + 2] for row in grid] for c in starts]
    panels.sort(key=lambda panel: sum(cell == 0 for row in panel for cell in row), reverse=True)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c, panel in zip(starts, panels):
        for r in range(rows):
            out[r][c:c + 2] = panel[r]
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p, p.read_text())
